game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit, a pit of deep shadow: the torchbearer must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the ore lift while the while-loop condition stays true and glow-eyed lurkers keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Shadow Pit: a pit of deep shadow
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 1: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for History/classification review.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Shadow Pit'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against glow-eyed lurkers in Shadow Pit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
source_player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about door_health to power up the torchbearer and open the ore lift.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
